description: This Java class 'MessagesView' is responsible for displaying log or message messages within a GUI application. It manages a styled text pane that shows incoming messages, formats messages based on their source class, and provides methods to clear or append messages.

classes.name: MessagesView
classes.description: A GUI component for displaying formatted messages in a scrollable text pane, with styling based on message source class.

methods.name: MessagesView
methods.description: Constructor initializing message styles, setting up message listener, and configuring text pane.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new message line to the text pane, applying style based on the message's class.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the text style (bold, italic, or default) based on the message source class.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Removes all messages from the document.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Public method to clear all messages from the view.
